checks.text: At night the shop is told its order will be checked in the morning

shots.caption: At night: the shop is told when the order will be looked at

notes: The night hours follow the app's own clock, which is set to UTC, six hours behind Bangladesh. To make the message appear I set the night hours to match the app's clock. With the clock left on UTC, a Dhaka shop would be told "night" at the wrong time of day.
did: Made the owner's night hours cover the present time, then opened the shop's ordering screen.
